Each network action has actual UTC timestamps around its tool invocation. Concurrent calls are indexed in invocation order, not completion order.
The displayed model label is GPT-6 Astra Pro and model inheritance was supplied by the parent; immutable backend identity is not exposed.
The input hash was supplied in the assignment and is recorded as supplied; the original opening-post edition is not established.
All 36 displayed query results are logged in engine order, including results outside the requested site filters. Search snippets are not counted as direct reads.
Full raw responses remained only in functions store. Some displayed tool output was truncated; stored response text was inspected locally without additional internet requests.

No original issue page, image, issue comments/status, linked PR, release, or later resolution was intentionally inspected. A different discussion's later comments appeared automatically and are disclosed.
All three returned links were discovered in search results and directly read. S3 and S4 are additional directly read context supporting the ELK candidate.
All tests are proposals. No graph was rendered, no sample was run, and no measured outcome is claimed.
Page summaries are paraphrases; no prose quotations are included. Search titles are retained as exact displayed metadata, including an unusually long excerpt used as a title.
Historical availability on 2024-01-01 and the user's actual library version remain unknown.

final_candidates.title: Handles - React Flow
final_candidates.product_feature: Multiple named handles, CSS positions, and useUpdateNodeInternals
final_candidates.exact_section: Using multiple handles, lines 410-427; Dynamic handles, lines 471-473.
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: The supplied request asks for automatic separation but provides no code. The image was not inspected; parallel edges and general fan-out remain possible interpretations.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: Adds a concrete endpoint-placement mechanism absent from the supplied text. It is not claimed unknown to the author.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Derive handle positions from incident-edge count, give handles stable distinct IDs, reference them from edges, and refresh geometry after changes.

minimal_discriminating_input.fixture: Two 120-pixel-high nodes; three parallel edges using separate handles on each facing side. Set y=(i+1)*120/(n+1). Add a fourth edge and recompute positions; compare with unchanged default-centered handles.

final_candidates.expected_output: Proposed expectation: endpoint offsets change from 30/60/90 to 24/48/72/96 pixels and edges follow after the internal update. Default-centered handles coincide.
final_candidates.conditions_supported: The guide documents named handles, CSS positioning, and dynamic geometry refresh. The equal-spacing formula is this arm's proposed implementation.
final_candidates.limitations: Distinct endpoints do not guarantee separated curves over their full length. Ordering, removals, node resizing, and the user's library version remain untested.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: Unique IDs alone leave multiple handles centered on the same side.
final_candidates.historical_availability: Unknown as of the request's 2024-01-01 posting; the inspected page is a later mutable edition.

final_candidates.title: Node Size Options (ELK)
final_candidates.version_or_date: Current mutable reference; release/publication date unknown.
final_candidates.exact_section: Additional Documentation, lines 21-31, especially PORTS_OVERHANG and UNIFORM_PORT_SPACING.
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: Automatic endpoint spacing can be delegated to a graph-layout component if node-layout and sizing changes are acceptable; that acceptance is not established.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: Adds a configurable equal-gap policy and an explicit choice for insufficient node space; no layout engine was mentioned in the input.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Consider ELK-managed port placement; choose uniform spacing for unequal labels and explicitly choose whether crowded ports may overhang.

minimal_discriminating_input.fixture: In a supporting ELK configuration, give one node three same-side ports with unequal label sizes. Compare uniform spacing off/on. Separately constrain that side to 40 pixels with three ports requesting 30-pixel gaps; compare overhang off/on.

final_candidates.expected_output: Documentation-based expectations: uniform mode equalizes label-driven gaps; overhang allows requested gaps beyond the boundary. Default crowded placement may reduce gaps.
final_candidates.conditions_supported: The option reference states both behaviors. S4 confirms Layered supports ports and multiple edges; S3 distinguishes port gaps from route gaps.
final_candidates.limitations: Exact configuration, React Flow coordinate transfer, full edge routing, and historical availability remain unknown. Node layout may change.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: Automatic layout alone does not guarantee equal spacing or fit within a fixed small node.
final_candidates.historical_availability: Unknown as of 2024-01-01; no historical edition or feature introduction was investigated.

final_candidates.title: addEdge() - React Flow
final_candidates.version_or_date: Current mutable API reference; release/publication date unknown.
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: Several edges between the same node pair may fail at insertion before any spacing logic runs; the user's insertion path is unknown.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: Adds a failure test that separates missing edge data from overlapping rendering; the input supplies no insertion implementation.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Inspect edge-array cardinality and endpoint handles before debugging geometry. Use distinct valid handles when separate endpoint identities suit the intended graph.

minimal_discriminating_input.fixture: Start with e1 from A/h1 to B/t1. Call addEdge for e2 with the same endpoints and a different ID. Repeat from the original array with e2 using a valid second source handle h2.

final_candidates.expected_output: Documentation-based expectation: the first call leaves one edge; changing the source-handle identity permits a second edge.
final_candidates.conditions_supported: The official Notes section explicitly defines duplicate equivalence using nodes and, when specified, their handle IDs.
final_candidates.limitations: No spacing behavior follows from insertion. Controlled edge-state alternatives were not investigated.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: A different edge ID alone does not bypass this duplicate check.
final_candidates.historical_availability: Unknown as of 2024-01-01; current behavior was directly read, not experimentally executed.
